cpi_point_in_time_source.series: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted
cpi_point_in_time_source.source: Archived August 2026 CPI news release, Table 1
cpi_point_in_time_source.verification_method: Both observation levels are published in the BLS archived August 2026 CPI release dated September 11, 2026; the release predates the October 5, 2026 decision date.
cpi_point_in_time_source.adjustment_method: Not seasonally adjusted CPI-U; year-over-year comparison of same-month indexes.
cpi_point_in_time_source.transformations: Inflation = 334.980 / 323.976 - 1. CPI + 4% target uses arithmetic addition, matching the project mandate convention.
cpi_point_in_time_source.note: This is point-in-time verified from the BLS release available on the decision date; it is not represented as an ALFRED API vintage.

dgs10_signal.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.15, via FRED/ALFRED
dgs10_signal.interpretation: 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield; descriptive macro regime indicator, not a return forecast.
dgs10_signal.action: Modeling assumption: use as a review trigger only; do not alter weights automatically. Rerun rates-sensitive valuation and approved stresses when elevated or materially changed.

stress_matrix.assumptions: Each numerical scenario is a modeling stress. Historical asset returns/covariance are altered mechanically; none is a forecast or verified market shock. Market returns are restricted to observation endpoints available on the signal decision date. No signal scenario changes weights because the approved signal role is review-only.

limitations: Historical arithmetic means are estimates, not forecasts or promised returns.
Turnover and transaction costs use a hypothetical equal-weight starting allocation and illustrative 10 bps cost; neither is actual Meridian evidence.
ETF five-business-day liquidity remains unverified, so no portfolio is reported as fully mandate-compliant.
The CPI pair uses the archived BLS August 2026 release available by the decision date; it is not an ALFRED API vintage and uses unadjusted CPI-U.
The 1% grid solution is discrete and may differ from a continuous optimum.

decision_support.candidate_action: HOLD funded deployment and do not authorize an allocation range yet; continue evidence collection and permit paper-only rehearsal if separately approved.

decision_framework.rule: Only after every applicable hard rule has documented PASS evidence, point-in-time objective inputs are valid, actual-holdings turnover and costs are supportable, the committee accepts S10's optimization objective and S9 handling, and allocation ranges remain acceptable across approved stresses.

Only after hard legal/mandate constraints and point-in-time data gates are verified, with actual holdings, pilot size, duration, authority, monitoring cadence, and abort conditions approved in writing. A paper-only rehearsal may be considered while capital gates remain open.

Use when material evidence or policy interpretation remains unknown, the estimate window produces material allocation dispersion, or feasibility depends on an inadmissible input. Do not authorize funded allocation.

Use when a verified hard constraint is breached or no feasible portfolio exists under confirmed policy and evidence, with no approved remedy. A hypothetical-start infeasibility alone is not grounds to reject Meridian's actual portfolio.

window_sensitivity.interpretation: The optimized BIL weight changes materially between the tested full and 36-month windows. The mandate supplies no approved tolerance for this dispersion; do not call the resulting envelope robust or authorize it as a band.

reasons_not_robust: Full versus 36-month estimation changes BIL by the reported percentage-point amount.
The mandate does not set a numerical tolerance for allocation stability, so a robust band cannot be inferred without committee judgment.
CPI is point-in-time verified from the BLS archived August release, not an ALFRED API vintage; this uses unadjusted CPI-U rather than seasonally adjusted CPIAUCSL.
Actual holdings, turnover, transaction costs, liquidity, issuer treatment/exposure, and S9 handling remain unverified.

evidence_requirements.available_evidence: SEC Rule 6c-11 materials and fund-provider pages disclose prior-day holdings, market/NAV information, and/or 30-day median bid-ask spread. These are useful diligence inputs, not proof that the proposed portfolio's required 90% can be sold and settled within five business days at the intended trade size.
evidence_requirements.needed: Dated holdings and executable, position-sized liquidation/settlement analysis for each proposed allocation under normal-market conditions; confirm treatment of ETF secondary-market sale versus fund redemption.

evidence_requirements.available_evidence: Lab_13.md says: No single issuer can account for more than 8% of the portfolio. The machine-readable project configuration carries case-exemption assumptions, but the quoted client rule does not state them. Public daily ETF holdings disclosures can support look-through aggregation; no dated constituents or CIO ruling is loaded in this project.
evidence_requirements.needed: CIO confirmation of exemptions and look-through method; dated underlying holdings and issuer aggregation if exemptions do not apply.

sources.title: SEC ETF Rule 6c-11 compliance guide (daily holdings disclosure)

evidence_requirements.available_evidence: The CPI pair is 2025-08-01=323.976 and 2026-08-01=334.98 (Index 1982-84=100); release availability is 2026-09-11, before decision date 2026-10-05. Inflation is 3.3965%; the arithmetic CPI + 4% hurdle is 7.3965%. Source: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_09112026.htm. This is BLS release evidence, not an ALFRED API vintage.
evidence_requirements.needed: For exact revised-series vintage reproduction, archive the underlying ALFRED response; this run relies on the contemporaneous BLS release and does not claim ALFRED API verification.

sources.title: FRED observations API and vintage_dates parameter

evidence_requirements.available_evidence: Lab_13.md describes an annual loss greater than 10% as an unverifiable promise and does not define measurement or breach handling. No external market source can supply this client-specific policy decision.
evidence_requirements.needed: CIO definition of calendar/fiscal/rolling year, NAV or market-price total return, fee/cost treatment, and breach escalation. Until then, display a human-review alert only; do not promise or encode a loss guarantee.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Point-in-time CPI or required market observation unavailable, revised without a recorded vintage, or dated after the decision boundary
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: STOP the decision run; do not reuse the prior hurdle as current or substitute a later release.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Optimizer returns infeasible, covariance validation fails, or required constraint cannot be evaluated
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: STOP and report the failed rule/input. Do not relax constraints or treat unknown as PASS.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Verified reserve falls below the mandate's required distribution coverage
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: Escalate before trading and restore the committee-approved reserve; current modeled floor is 3% only under the stated $0.75m quarterly distribution assumption.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Verified five-day liquid share falls below 90% or a position-sized liquidation test fails
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: STOP new allocations and obtain committee-approved remediation; ETF headline volume or median spread alone is insufficient.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Aggregated nonexempt issuer exposure exceeds 8% under a CIO-confirmed S6 interpretation
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: Block the proposed trade and obtain committee direction; no exemption is presumed.
Do not rebalance absent the committee approval explicitly required by S7; current holdings are missing, so modeled turnover is illustrative only.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Rolling five-year after-cost return falls below the CPI + 4% objective using admissible vintages
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: Trigger committee review and rerun the analysis; this is an objective review trigger, not a guaranteed return or automatic liquidation rule.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: DGS10 is unavailable at the decision date
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: Mark the signal unavailable and proceed without an automatic portfolio tilt; obtain a fresh permitted observation before using it as a review input.
Human-review alert only pending CIO definition of S9. Do not represent this as a verified breach or automatic sell rule.

monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.trigger: Proposed weights lie outside a subsequently committee-approved allocation range
monitoring_triggers_and_stop_conditions.response: STOP that trade pending review. The current stress envelope is not an approved range.

reversal_conditions.condition: Point-in-time CPI and all required data are valid; actual holdings/costs are recorded; S3, S5, S6, S7 and S8 have documented treatment/evidence; the CIO approves S9 handling and the committee sets pilot size, authority, duration, review cadence, and abort conditions.
Any required observation is unavailable or revised without vintage evidence, an optimizer/covariance stop occurs, a mandatory rule becomes untestable, or a pilot monitoring trigger is breached.
A hard mandate violation is verified and no committee-approved exception or feasible remedy exists. Hypothetical equal-weight turnover infeasibility alone does not meet this condition.

Only after the committee-defined pilot review period is complete, outcomes and actual costs reconcile to the pre-approved plan, constraints remain verified, and the committee accepts a stress-supported allocation range.

committee_decisions_requested: Confirm that the archived BLS not-seasonally-adjusted CPI-U release is the preferred operational interpretation of the CPI + 4% mandate, or require a contemporaneous ALFRED CPIAUCSL vintage before adoption.
Provide Meridian's actual holdings and holdings as-of date, plus an approved transaction-cost estimate or execution evidence.
Confirm whether the S6 exemptions in config/mandate.json govern despite their absence from the S6 sentence in Lab_13.md; approve look-through and issuer aggregation treatment.
Provide position-sized five-business-day sale and settlement evidence for the 90% liquidity rule.
Define how S9 is measured and handled, and confirm the minimum-volatility objective as a modeling choice under S10.
Decide whether the model-only stress envelope is useful for discussion; no allocation range is recommended for authorization in this report.

optimizer_precision_validation.method: Production exhaustive 1% grid compared with exhaustive 0.5% grid and SciPy SLSQP continuous variance minimization from four starting points; all use identical long-only, full-investment, reserve, provisional after-cost return, and illustrative-cost inputs.
optimizer_precision_validation.conclusion: The production 1% grid is within one percentage point of the continuous solution on every weight; finer-grid and continuous results are retained for review.
